title: UAAP: FEU-Diliman, UST still unbeaten in boys' volleyball
summary: Far Eastern University–Diliman and University of Santo Tomas remain undefeated in the UAAP Season 89 boys' volleyball tournament after overcoming separate opponents on Sunday at the Blue Eagle Gym.
